RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel is a documented risk factor for unconscious in-group bias, but on its own, it does not prove sex discrimination. For head-of-lab positions, search committees often weigh formal management training and broad leadership history above academic qualifications like a PhD. 

However, panel homogeneity alongside the delayed written feedback warrants scrutiny. Do not lead with accusations of bias yet. Instead, follow up firmly on your feedback request to understand the objective scoring criteria used. If the explanation is evasive, subjective, or indicates that your qualifications were improperly discounted relative to the job specification, you will have stronger grounds to raise concerns with HR or a staff representative.
